scope: User-supplied passive isotropic optical data, continuous or fixed-dt ADE target, native Python/UI and CPU/CUDA/tensor execution.
objective: Required checklist items in priority order. Conditional items only for concrete use cases. No new implementation of excluded product-specific replication.
independent_checks: Authored constant, Lorentz, Drude, mixed and narrow responses with held-out wavelengths
Positive loss over a dense positive-frequency sweep
Noisy data, input units, duplicate rejection, fixed epsilon infinity, data-band limits and explicit unmet tolerance
Native discrete D/E driven independently over 8192 steps
Browser CSV import, failed tolerance, candidate apply, JSON/Python persistence, actual overridden timestep and native GPU execution
Stale browser fit results discarded after input changes
limitations: Authored-data checks do not validate every measured material
Subpixel curved/dispersive interface accuracy remains the next required work
No new Lumerical calculation or commercial optical-data redistribution
Finite-band nonlinear fitting has local minima and no unique-fit guarantee
